chains.frame: Which word best describes the result of Priyanka and Ellis working together?

beats.text: Separately, Priyanka and Ellis each managed one good slide an hour; editing one another’s work, they finished three strong slides an hour.
beats.decisive_clue: joint output exceeds their separate production rates
beats.reason: Joint output exceeds their separate production rates is the strongest evidence for synergy here.

beats.text: They used different laptop brands while preparing those slides.
beats.decisive_clue: joint output exceeds their separate production rates; different laptop brands does not change that
beats.reason: The extra output created by combining efforts remains the decisive fact; laptop brands are irrelevant.

chains.feedback_short: Joint output exceeds their separate production rates still decides; the later detail does not change that.
chains.feedback_deep: Synergy means extra effectiveness produced by combined work beyond separate efforts; symbiosis means a close ongoing mutually supportive relationship between unlike groups or organisms. The extra output created by combining efforts remains the decisive fact; laptop brands are irrelevant.
chains.contrast_rule: Synergy: joint effort achieves more than separate work; symbiosis: different groups depend on each other.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the relationship between Amina’s bakery and a nearby café?

beats.text: For four years the bakery has supplied bread to the café, while the café sends steady customers to the bakery.
beats.decisive_clue: two different businesses repeatedly help one another
beats.reason: Two different businesses repeatedly help one another is the strongest evidence for symbiosis here.

beats.text: Each business plans its weekly supplies around that continuing exchange.
beats.decisive_clue: two different businesses repeatedly help one another; further evidence: weekly planning depends on the continuing exchange
beats.reason: The extra detail reveals durable mutual reliance rather than a single productivity boost.
